_comment: banned = unambiguous mainland terms (validate errors). watch = context-sensitive terms (validate warnings; they do not fail the command). exceptions suppress a hit: patterns are compounds that may contain the term (處理程序 is not a 程序 hit); keys suppress that term on those catalog paths. A term may stay banned while specific hits are excepted. simplifiedChars = characters that only exist in Simplified Chinese.
